title: pgmandate delivery, version 2
description: The body pgmandate posts to a webhook action's URL when a proposal has been approved by a person or executed under a mandate, signed with Ed25519 over 'pgmandate-v2.' + the Mandate-Timestamp header + '.' + the raw body; the Mandate-Signature header is 'v2 kid=<key id> sig=<base64>'. Within one address and audience the body is the same on every attempt; the time of an attempt is in the Mandate-Timestamp header. A receiver checks, in this order: the signature, with a key it trusts; that version is 2, kind is delivery and audience and tenantId are the ones it was configured with, answering 403 without an outcome otherwise; that it has not seen deliveryId (a delivery it finished is answered as before, one in progress with 503); and that its clock is before notAfter. It answers with an explicit outcome: {"outcome":"done","result":{...}}, {"outcome":"refused","refusal":{...}} or {"outcome":"unknown","reason":"..."}. Anything else is retried, and a delivery whose attempts may have reached the receiver without an outcome ends unknown, for a person to settle. Fields may be added within a version, so a receiver ignores fields it does not know. A removed field or a changed meaning is a new version, which a receiver answers like a delivery not for it: 403 without an outcome, never a refusal.

kind.description: What this signed body is. A receiver of deliveries accepts delivery only.

audience.description: Who this delivery is for: pgm:<tenant>:<action>:<16 hex digits>. The receiver is configured with its audience and refuses any other; it never takes it from the request. A new one is drawn when the action moves or is defined anew.

deliveryId.description: The id of this delivery, the same on every attempt and equal to the Mandate-Delivery-Id header. Claim it before acting, and do the work once.

correlationId.description: One value to join logs on across every system: the run id the agent gave when it proposed, otherwise the proposal's id. The agent knows it either way, and several deliveries of one run share it. A run id is chosen by the agent, so this is a label, not an identity: the proposal's id and the agent's id are what identify the work.

createdAt.description: When the delivery was recorded, in the transaction of the decision. RFC 3339, UTC.

notAfter.description: When the receiver must no longer carry this delivery out: the decision's time plus the action's delivery window. A delivery the receiver never started that arrives after it is refused without acting, and work under way is never committed after it. RFC 3339, UTC.

action.description: The key of the action, such as tickets.create.

payload.description: What the agent proposed, or what a person edited it to. It fits the action's own payload schema as that schema was when the decision was made.

runId.description: The agent's own id for a chain of work, when it gave one. Left out otherwise.

status.description: approved: a person decided. executed: a mandate allowed it without a person.

decidedBy.description: The person who approved. Left out for an execution.

edited.description: Whether a person changed the title or the payload on approval.

executionBasis.description: What allowed an execution without a person. Left out for an approval.

budgets.description: The mandate's budgets as this execution saw them. Today one, of kind count: how many executions the mandate may allow per UTC calendar month (limit), and how many it had allowed this month before this one (spent).

condition.description: The mandate's condition on the payload, which held for it, for the record. Left out when the mandate has none. Do not evaluate it again: check the facts in the payload against your own records.
